visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a vertical photo of a young couple wearing graduation gowns, holding balloons and a gift bag, with text indicating their 10th anniversary. This transitions to the couple sitting together on a modern sofa in a brightly lit living room, waving and smiling at the camera. (2) The scene shifts as the male character introduces the first relationship tip. They are shown writing in gratitude journals while sitting on the floor in front of a coffee table. Close-up shots show the handwriting and pages of the journals. They return to the sofa to discuss the habit. (3) A brief comedic interlude occurs where the man pretends to fall asleep instantly on the woman's lap after they hold hands. The woman laughs and pushes him playfully. The lighting remains warm and domestic. (4) The female character introduces the second tip: spending one hour together daily. A rapid montage follows, showing them walking in the city with groceries, riding yellow bicycles through urban streets and parks, running on an athletic track, dancing together in their living room, and hiking on a sunlit forest trail. (5) The video concludes with the couple back on the sofa, wrapping up their advice with happy expressions and hand gestures, emphasizing deep communication and personal growth.
